claims.text: When an auth collection allows both email and a username-style text field as identity fields, a record whose username value is formatted like an email address (and differs from its email) can log in via auth-with-password by supplying that username as the identity.
Logging in with the record's real email address keeps working in collections that also use a username identity field.
Login attempts with an email-like identity are still refused when the password is incorrect or the value matches no record's identity fields.
